'''Brad Stebbins''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 4th at [[June 2000 Clear Lake tournament]] on 24 June 2000, according to Seth Van Winkle's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d950">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-28-clear-lake-iowa-6-24-00d950/ clear-lake-iowa-6-24-00], DeckTech (Seth "Ooryl" Van Winkle, 28 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-28-clear-lake-iowa-6-24-00d950/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
